editorial.blurb: A lively all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ spot where you grab raw meat from the fridge, cook it tableside, and let the sauces do the heavy lifting—casual, fun, and surprisingly affordable.
editorial.insiderTip: Order via the tablet for some items, but walk straight to the refrigerated meat section to grab what you want; ask staff for a fresh grill grate when yours gets charred, and load up on the included side plates and dessert to maximize your value.
